protanopia_description.message: A protanope is a person who does not perceive the color red. Reds, oranges, and yellows appear darker, while greens and blues appear brighter.

deuteranopia_description.message: A deuteranope is a person who does not perceive the color green. Greens appear darker, while reds and browns appear brighter.

tritanopia_description.message: A tritanope is a person who does not perceive the color blue. Blues appear darker, while yellows and reds appear brighter.

achromatopsia_description.message: An achromatope is a person who does not perceive color. Colors appear as shades of gray.

blur_vision.description: Title for the blurred vision filter

blur_vision_description.message: Blurred vision reduces the sharpness of edges and details, making everything look slightly veiled or hazy.

simulate.description: Button to apply the simulation filters

update_title.description: Title of the notification when the extension is updated

update_message.message: What's new: blurry vision, side panel, context menu, intensity sliders, multilingual support.
